name: og-image
about: The edit og-image.record.ts makes for public/og-image.jpg, on DSCF8005.RAF (github.com/theseamusjames/sample-raf-images): recipe paths and values, as LibrarySession.editRecipe takes them. The crop is the card's shape, 1200:630, with the divider (the middle) through the spritz glass. The profile stays the camera's look, which is what the split view's Before shows.
